sources.name: osm_pois
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, tags -> 'name:ku' AS name_ku, tags -> 'name:ckb' AS name_ckb, tags -> 'addr:city' AS locality, tags -> 'addr:province' AS region, tags -> 'addr:district' AS neighbourhood, tags -> 'addr:country' AS country_a, amenity, shop, tourism, leisure, office, brand, operator, tags -> 'phone' AS phone, tags -> 'contact:phone' AS contact_phone, tags -> 'website' AS website, tags -> 'contact:website' AS contact_website, tags -> 'opening_hours' AS opening_hours, "addr:housenumber" AS housenumber, "addr:housename" AS housename, way FROM planet_osm_point WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> '' AND (amenity IS NOT NULL OR shop IS NOT NULL OR tourism IS NOT NULL OR leisure IS NOT NULL OR office IS NOT NULL)

sources.name: streets
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, tags -> 'name:ku' AS name_ku, tags -> 'name:ckb' AS name_ckb, tags -> 'addr:city' AS locality, tags -> 'addr:province' AS region, tags -> 'addr:district' AS neighbourhood, highway, ref, way FROM planet_osm_line WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> '' AND highway IN ('motorway', 'trunk', 'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'unclassified', 'residential', 'service', 'living_street', 'pedestrian')

sources.name: places
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, tags -> 'name:ku' AS name_ku, tags -> 'name:ckb' AS name_ckb, place, population, capital, way FROM planet_osm_point WHERE place IN ('city', 'town', 'village', 'suburb', 'neighbourhood', 'hamlet') AND name IS NOT NULL AND name <> ''

sources.name: admin_boundaries
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, name, tags -> 'name:en' AS name_en, tags -> 'name:ar' AS name_ar, tags -> 'name:ku' AS name_ku, tags -> 'name:ckb' AS name_ckb, CASE WHEN admin_level = '2' THEN tags -> 'ISO3166-1:alpha2' END AS country_a, CASE WHEN admin_level = '4' THEN tags -> 'ISO3166-2' END AS region_a, CASE WHEN admin_level = '2' THEN name END AS country, CASE WHEN admin_level = '4' THEN name END AS region, CASE WHEN admin_level = '6' THEN name END AS county, CASE WHEN admin_level = '8' THEN name END AS locality, CASE WHEN admin_level = '9' THEN name END AS localadmin, CASE WHEN admin_level = '10' THEN name END AS neighbourhood, boundary, admin_level, way FROM planet_osm_polygon WHERE boundary = 'administrative' AND admin_level IN ('2', '4', '6', '8', '9', '10') AND name IS NOT NULL AND name <> ''

sources.name: addresses
sources.sql: SELECT osm_id, COALESCE(tags -> 'addr:housename', tags -> 'addr:housenumber') AS name, tags -> 'addr:housenumber' AS housenumber, tags -> 'addr:street' AS street, tags -> 'addr:postcode' AS postalcode, tags -> 'addr:city' AS locality, tags -> 'addr:province' AS region, tags -> 'addr:district' AS neighbourhood, tags -> 'addr:country' AS country_a, way FROM planet_osm_point WHERE tags ? 'addr:housenumber' AND tags -> 'addr:housenumber' <> ''
